title: helm(private): values templating + init-hooks validation and rollback stability
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: private deployments have shown recurring failures during upgrades where init-hooks (postgres/initjobs, kms/secret bootstrap) and templated values interact with rollback paths. This PR centralizes values schema templating for private charts, adds stronger validation for KMS/postgres init hooks, and improves hook ordering and rollback stability. Changes include: 1) values.schema.json: introduce templating-aware schema entries for .private.kms and .private.postgres sections and add conditional validation messages to surface misconfigurations earlier; 2) templates/init-jobs/*: consolidate postgres-initjob and kms-bootstrap into idempotent, ordered hooks with 'pre-upgrade' and 'pre-install' annotations and deterministic weight ordering to ensure consistent behavior on retries; 3) templates/_helpers.tpl & values.yaml: add helper templates for nodeSelector/tolerations merging and a templating API to allow environment variable substitution in values (opt-in via private.valuesTemplating.enabled); 4) hooks: add explicit helm hook-delete-policy and test for successful completion to avoid orphaned jobs on failed upgrades; 5) chart: bump Chart.yaml version and add CHANGELOG entry; 6) tests: add helm template/unit test to validate schema failure modes and a small e2e fixture that simulates upgrade + rollback cycle. Migration notes: enabling valuesTemplating is opt-in; existing installs are unaffected. If using KMS with autoProvision: true ensure service account and KMS key ARN are present or the helm validation will fail fast. Rollback behavior: improved hook-delete-policy and idempotent init jobs reduce the chance of stuck releases requiring manual cleanup. Checklist: - [x] values schema updates - [x] init-job refactor + weights - [x] templating opt-in flag and helpers - [x] unit + e2e tests - [x] reviewers feedback addressed
commits: refactor(helm): extract templating helpers and node/toleration merge logic
feat(helm): add valuesTemplating opt-in and templating-aware schema entries
fix(helm): make kms and postgres init jobs idempotent and add deterministic hook weights
test(helm): add unit tests for schema validation and upgrade/rollback fixture
chore(chart): bump chart version and add changelog entry
review_comments: Jordan Li: The deterministic weights look good but please explain the idempotency guarantees in the job templates - what happens if the init-job partially completes?

Ava Chen (author): Added retry/backoff logic and k8s job completion check; job writes a cluster-scoped ConfigMap 'private-init-complete' with a stable name to short-circuit subsequent runs. If a partial run leaves resources, the job attempts cleanup on next run.
Priya Singh: Can we gate templating behind an opt-in flag? I worry about users relying on literal values being mutated.
Ava Chen: Yes, valuesTemplating.enabled defaults to false. Updated values.yaml and docs in README to highlight opt-in behavior.
Ethan Park: CI unit tests flaked on Helm 3.8 matrix job originally. Looks stable after bumping helm unit harness and adding explicit namespace scoping.
Jordan Li: Approved after author addressed idempotency and added release note entry.
release_notes: Fix: stabilize init-hook ordering and rollback behavior for redwood-private helm chart; Feature: opt-in values templating for private deployments; Validation: early schema checks for KMS and Postgres config to prevent failed upgrades. Users should opt into valuesTemplating explicitly; see charts/redwood-private/README for migration notes.
